what: a stand-in North Atlantic overcast (hand-made, not the battle's): the stand-in convoy night's own pieces and tracks by day under a closed deck, for the fleet's clouds and weather (Tools/sea_waves/stand-ins/weather_days.py, the release 2 ocean plan step 13)

field.title: A convoy under a winter overcast (stand-in)

events.text: A U-boat reports the convoy.
Escort 1 has a radar contact.
A shell from a U-boat's deck gun hits Merchant 3.
Boat C opens fire on Merchant 3 with her deck gun.
Boat A dives.
Merchant 3's gunners return fire on the U-boat.
Boat B fires a salvo at the convoy.
Escort 1 has a contact.
Merchant 3 is hit again by the U-boat's gun.
Two more shells hit Merchant 3.
Merchant 3's gunners hit the U-boat.
Merchant 3's gunners hit the U-boat again.
Boat C dives.
A torpedo hits Merchant 1.
Merchant 1 breaks in two and goes down.
Escort 2 has a contact.
Boat B goes deep.
Escort 3 has a contact.
Escort 3 drops a pattern on Boat A.
Boat A is damaged.
Escort 2 drops a pattern on Boat B.
Boat B is damaged.
Boat A is forced to the surface.
Boat A's crew make for her deck gun.
Merchant 12's gunners open fire on the surfaced U-boat.
Escort 3 sights the boat on the surface.
Boat A's crew give her up.
Boat A is scuttled by her crew.
Escort 2 regains the contact.
Escort 2 fires ahead at Boat B.
Boat B is hit.
Boat B is lost with all hands.
Escort 1 picks up survivors.

lines: One merchant lost; two boats sunk.
